meta.templateNote: Webhook-triggered by the app's ALREADY-BUILT outbound event system (infrastructure/webhooks/outbound-webhook.ts, application/automation/webhook-dispatch.ts) — no app-side code changes needed, unlike workflows 08/09. Requires an admin to enable the webhook at /admin/automation, paste this workflow's Production URL in, and copy the app-generated signing secret into DREAMRUE_WEBHOOK_SHARED_SECRET here. Four events land on this one URL: lead.created_or_updated and lead.status_changed carry { event, companyId, timestamp, data: Lead[] } (bare array, see webhook-dispatch.ts::projectLeadForWebhook); lead.matched and alert.fired carry { event, companyId, timestamp, data: { ruleId, ruleName, [channel, recipient,] leads: Lead[] } } (see application/alerting/dispatch.ts) — the two shapes are NOT the same, branch accordingly downstream. The four 'extend me' NoOp nodes are intentional stubs — what happens per event (Slack post, CRM upsert, WhatsApp broadcast, spreadsheet row) is a business decision this plan deliberately leaves open, not an omission.
